name: Chromatic Riser Sweep
desc: A sawtooth climbing the C-minor scale over eight cycles with an opening filter and dub delay — the euphoric build sweep from full_show's Crescendo.

code.sparse: note("c4 eb4 g4 bb4 c5 eb5 g5 bb5".slow(16)).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${lo}, ${hi}*.7).slow(16)).attack(.05).decay(.5).sustain(.4).release(.4).gain(${gain}*.8).delay(.25).delaytime(.15).delayfeedback(.3).room(.8).roomsize(9).every(8, x => x.rev()).orbit(7).play()
code.full: note("c4 d4 eb4 f4 g4 ab4 bb4 c5 d5 eb5 f5 g5 ab5 bb5 c6 d6".slow(8)).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${lo}, ${hi}).slow(8)).attack(.01).decay(.3).sustain(.2).release(.2).gain(${gain}).delay(.2).delaytime(.15).delayfeedback(.35).room(.7).roomsize(8).every(4, x => x.rev()).orbit(7).play()
code.peak: note("c4 d4 eb4 f4 g4 ab4 bb4 c5 d5 eb5 f5 g5 ab5 bb5 c6 d6".slow(4)).add(note(${root})).add(note("0,12")).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${lo}*1.5, ${hi}).slow(4)).attack(.005).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.2).gain(${gain}).delay(.15).delaytime(.09375).delayfeedback(.45).room(.6).roomsize(7).every(4, x => x.fast(2)).orbit(7).play()
